Why you

You know every landlord, manager and chef within ten miles, and they all trust you. I know social media for hospitality and how to make it simple. Put the two together and we can help a lot of pubs, hotels and restaurants fill their tables, and you earn properly for doing something you are already brilliant at: talking to people.

The job

You become a sales partner for Freehold Socials, my social media service for pubs, bars, hotels and restaurants. Your job is to talk to venues, tell them what we do, send them your own link, and chase it up once. I do everything after that: the content, the posting and the looking after them. You never touch the social media.

You choose your own hours and how many people you speak to. Five a day is fine. Fifty a day is also fine.

You can reach venues however suits you: a phone call, a message or a voicenote. You can do it from your own pages, or I can log you into the Freehold Socials account so you reach out as Freehold. Your choice, and you can mix the two.

These are our current offers for pubs, bars, hotels and restaurants. We sell them as 3, 6 or 12 month packages, because that is how a venue gets results and how you get paid properly. Savings are against our normal £200 a month. The longer they commit, the more they save, which makes your job easy: you are not selling, you are showing them a better deal.

The only month by month option is the Freehold Socials portal at £99 a month, for a pub that wants ready to post content and will post it themselves.

Your sweeteners

  • Free sample. Any venue can fill in a short form and I will make them free posts. It takes the risk away, so it is the easiest first yes. If a venue gets a free sample from your link and comes on board, you get paid.
  • Free content day. Anyone in West Yorkshire who signs up for 6 months or more gets a free content day with me, so we can take photos and video of their venue. Your local pubs are right in that area.
